pitches.logline: Levan wants a used silver sedan before dark. The seller swears it runs like oil, but the idle shakes and nobody can say why.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the car coughs into a rough idle while the seller slaps the bonnet and yells the opposite; Levan freezes, keys in hand. Sound real-rough-idle.
pitches.heroObject: the OBD adapter in the socket under the wheel

pitches.logline: Dato's cousin swears he fixed the car by clearing the lamp, but the cause never left and the lamp keeps coming back.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the cousin yells that he cleared it as the engine misfires and Dato flinches. Sound real-misfire.

pitches.logline: Giorgi's crossover shakes on the way home; every friend and mechanic he calls guesses something else.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the car shudders at a stop while a mechanic's verdict comes through the speaker. Sound real-phone-buzz.

treatment.logline: Levan wants a used silver sedan before dark. The seller swears it runs like oil, but the idle shakes and nobody can say why.
treatment.hero: Levan, late 20s, buying his first car, on one used-car lot with the same silver sedan all film
treatment.obstacle: a smiling seller who explains every shake away, and a 'today only' price

hook.event: the silver sedan idles rough on the lot while the seller slaps the bonnet and yells that it runs like oil; Levan freezes with the keys

act1: the check lamp is on and the seller laughs it off as just a sensor
on the test lap the car stalls at the lot's gate and the seller blames cold fuel
back on the lot it shakes a third time, the price is 'today only', Levan grips the keys: buy or walk
treatment.turn: a beat of silence on the shake counter, then Levan remembers the adapter in his pocket

reveal.what: the adapter in the socket under the wheel at knee height, its light on

screens.step: the black OBD scanner card in diagnostics
tap scan: the app reads the car
the answer, the reason and the deciding code

treatment.payoff: the same lot and car: Levan calmly shows the seller the phone, 'not like oil, like P0300', and the seller goes quiet
treatment.signature: the code P0300 taken apart (CodeAnatomy) after a ScreenTour of the real result; the shake counter that grows through act 1
treatment.heroObject: the OBD adapter in the socket under the wheel
